explication: This repository is a course collection of independent vanilla-JavaScript browser projects, not one integrated application. Users open a project and interact with its page; each project owns its own state and presentation. The README documents 20 projects, so all are represented even where source was not sampled. External service links are included only where sampled code shows requests or browser APIs; unsampled projects use their exact directory paths, and their internal wiring is not inferred.
